title: Capitolo 6 · Must, can, want — daily routine and work
shortDescription: The modal verbs dovere, potere and volere + infinitive and polite requests, the reflexive verbs of the daily routine (mi sveglio, mi alzo…) with the time, jobs and workplaces (che lavoro fai?), reading a job advert and booking an appointment on the phone with Lei.
description:
Part of the official SS Europa Italian course used in our classes, for learners from India, Pakistan and Bangladesh who are going to Italy to work, study or live. Chapters 1–7 take you from zero to level A1 and Chapters 8–12 to level A2 — study them in order.

Every 60-minute class of the chapter is split into three short lessons you can study on your phone, with pictures, audio, grammar tables and exercises. Every word comes with its English and Punjabi meaning, the slides of each class are attached as PDF, and the chapter ends with a test (pass mark 60%).
objectives:
I can say what I must, can and want to do: devo lavorare, posso entrare?, voglio imparare
I can ask politely: Posso uscire un attimo? Puoi ripetere? Vorrei un'informazione
I can describe my daily routine with reflexive verbs and the time
I can say what job I do and where I work
I can read a simple job advert: full-time, part-time, contratto, stipendio, esperienza
I can phone an employer and book an appointment using Lei

blocks.body: The pronoun goes **before** the verb: *Io **mi** sveglio alle sette.* The verb ending is the normal present tense (alz**o**, alz**i**, alz**a**…).

blocks.title: Analizziamo un annuncio vero
blocks.body:
**OFFERTA DI LAVORO • MANTOVA — Cercasi cameriere / a**

- Orario: part-time (solo sera)
- Si richiede minima esperienza
- Contratto a norma di legge
- Chiamare il 333-4567890

**1. Che lavoro è?** Cameriere o cameriera al ristorante.
**2. Qual è l'orario?** Part-time, lavoro solo la sera.
**3. Cosa devo fare?** Telefonare per fissare un appuntamento.

blocks.title: Test Capitolo 6
blocks.body:
This test checks everything in Chapter 6 (Lessons 1–4).

- **1. Listening** — sentences and a phone call for a job appointment
- **2. Vocabulary** — jobs, routine and job adverts
- **3. Grammar** — dovere, potere, volere and reflexive verbs
- **4. Writing** — sentences about your routine, your job and an appointment

You need **60%** to pass. You can repeat the test as many times as you like.

blocks.title: Good to know
blocks.body: The **written part** (my routine, my job, an appointment) and the **oral interview** (routine, jobs and modal verbs, a formal phone call — 2 minutes) are done **with your teacher** in the live class.
